ideas.pitch: An intelligent repository onboarding agent that indexes open-source codebases to auto-generate interactive architecture maps and personalized first-issue paths for new contributors.
ideas.title: OpenSource Onboarding Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the core open-source contribution mission of Winter of Code and mirrors the engineering team lifecycle intelligence pattern from devflow.

ideas.pitch: An automated proposal scoring and feedback engine for open-source mentor organizations to evaluate student project applications against historical successfully merged PRs.
ideas.title: GSoC Proposal Evaluator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the GSoC-inspired format of Winter of Code by solving a major organizational bottleneck during mentor review phases.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first local AI commit message and code quality reviewer running on local models to enforce contribution standards before push.
ideas.title: GitCommit Quality Gate
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the offline AI code review pattern from DevMesh directly to the 'every commit counts' tagline of Winter of Code 6.0.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent that triages incoming GitHub issues, labels them, links duplicate bug reports, and drafts reproducible test cases.
ideas.title: OS Maintainer Autonomous Triage Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the autonomous incident response pattern from BlackBox to solve a universally felt pain for the open-source maintainers reviewing Winter of Code PRs.

ideas.pitch: A real-time visualizer mapping cross-repository dependencies and contributor impact metrics across multi-project open-source organizations.
ideas.title: RepoDependency Graph Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers genuine hard engineering visualization that helps organizers track complex student contributions during the three-month initiative.
